_readme: Manual 2026/27 projection overrides · the things a last-season model cannot know: fitness, new role, regression, and who is unavailable for specific gameweeks. Keyed by FPL player code. `minutes` = expected 26/27 minutes (points are recomputed from the per-90 rate); `pts_mult` = a regression haircut on projected points; `benched`/`nailed` = shortcuts (config.PROJECTION_OVERRIDE minutes); `miss_gws` = a list of gameweeks the player is not expected to feature in, applied per gameweek rather than to the season total. `note` shows on the board. Edit freely · the Value Board reloads this file.
